missing: Help sizing to the shopper's own loads (what they want to run, for how long) and consistent long-term reliability, cycle-life and warranty-support data; the tested sources also disagree on the best 1kWh pick (Delta 3 vs Anker C1000 Gen 2 vs Bluetti Elite 100 V2) without reconciling why.
why: Consumer Reports and OutdoorGearLab both lab-test and name picks, backed by substantive bench-tested niche reviews (solarpowerauditor, The Inertia, Bob Vila); the remaining results are untested spec listicles and one unreadable TechRadar page.
